rounds.response:
1) The /admin/workspaces/export endpoint allows tenant admins to request an asynchronous export of their tenant's workspaces.  
2) The feature is gated by the enable_bulk_workspace_export flag (the endpoint returns 404 when the flag is off); when enabled the POST accepts an optional "status" filter to export only workspaces with that status, and omitting "status" exports all workspaces for the tenant.
